corridor_notes: Official completion/acceptance notice (竣工环境保护验收调查报告公示, jsaeit.com, published 2022-10-17) for '"川气东送"江苏配套管线一期工程项目' states: '本项目主干线共分为三段，A段为薛埠分输站-镇江上党分输站，B段为镇江上党分输站-南京靖安分输站、C段为镇江上党分输站-江阴顾山分输站，管线总长度约为218km' (the trunk splits into 3 sections at 上党/Shangdang: A) Xuebu-Shangdang, B) Shangdang-Nanjing Jing'an, and C) Shangdang-Jiangyin Gushan; combined length ~218km). Design pressure 6.3MPa, diameter 813mm, operating pressure 4.0MPa, annual capacity 6.9 billion m3. This exactly matches GEM's LengthMergedKm (218.00) and segment label ('Jintan-Gushan trunk'), i.e. GEM's row corresponds to the combined A+C path via Shangdang (the B branch to Nanjing Jing'an is a separate spur, not part of this PID). A second independent source (Wuxi Municipal Public Utilities Group / wxszjt.com, via Wayback snapshot 2022-10-04, since the live page now 405s) corroborates the general entry-into-Jiangsu routing: '川气东送管道进入江苏后经金坛、镇江分输站一路至南京，一路向东经常州、江阴，接入无锡市' (after entering Jiangsu the pipeline runs via Jintan and Zhenjiang distribution stations toward Nanjing on one route, and east via Changzhou and Jiangyin to Wuxi on another) -- consistent with the Jintan (Xuebu) hub branching toward both Nanjing and Jiangyin/Wuxi.
researcher_notes: Strong 2-source corroboration and an exact length match (218km) to GEM's LengthMergedKm gives high confidence in both endpoint identity and the Xuebu/Jintan-to-Gushan/Jiangyin routing via the Shangdang (Zhenjiang) junction. Waypoint 镇江上党分输站 (Shangdang Distribution Station, Dantu District, Zhenjiang; Nominatim relation 19110648, 32.0739149/119.4144712) sits on the actual corridor and should be used as an intermediate vertex when drawing the candidate route, not a straight line.
